slices.focus: Tasha builds a monthly dashboard tracking referrals, first contact, volunteer risk, and attendance by region
slices.summary: Tasha's ad hoc partner updates evolve into a formal monthly dashboard tracking referral source, first-contact completion, volunteer coverage risk, and group attendance by Wake County region. Miriam begins taking the reports into leadership meetings, giving bereavement an operational artifact in the room for the first time. The agent helps Tasha plan a three-sentence monthly readout (what improved, where risk is rising, what action would help most), keep the regional breakout as nonnegotiable, present first-contact metrics as 'service reliability' rather than surveillance, and document the hidden triage labor behind the dashboard to prevent the organization from treating it as effortless. Tasha starts a running note on questions asked, decisions made, and manual cleanup required.
